description: This PHP class 'ConsoleMilestoneListener' listens to various project and investment events in the Goteo crowdfunding platform to create milestones and trigger related actions such as notifications and event logging.

classes.name: ConsoleMilestoneListener
classes.description: A listener class that handles project milestones creation based on project publish, activation, reward fulfillment, and investment success events.

methods.name: create_milestone
methods.description: Creates a milestone for a project based on the specified type, handling duplicate events and saving the milestone.

methods.name: onProjectPublish
methods.description: Handles the event when a project is published, creating an 'on-publish' milestone.

methods.name: onProjectActive
methods.description: Handles the event when a project becomes active, creating a milestone based on days.

methods.name: onProjectWatch
methods.description: Handles the event when a project is watched, creating milestones if rewards are fulfilled.

methods.name: onInvestSucceeded
methods.description: Handles the event when an investment succeeds, creating milestones based on investment percentage, amount, and number of donors.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this listener subscribes to and their corresponding handler methods.
